create_log_targets: create log targets with stdout or file handlers and a name prefix for distributed logging
log_json: log a JSON event with timestamp to one or multiple loggers
create_log_target_file: create a file-based logger with timed rotation per host and distributed rank
create_log_target_stdout: create a stdout logger with a given name prefix
create_logger_with_handler: create a logger with a handler, info level, no propagation, and message-only format
